name: heads
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Correct the head artwork of this existing chestnut-haired amber-eyed chibi young-adult fantasy adventurer for a modular 2D game. Reference 1 gives identity and style. Reference 2 gives existing side-view character.
Create ONE transparent PNG sprite atlas, landscape 3:1, exactly THREE separate heads arranged in three equally sized cells with generous clear margins.
LEFT CELL: perfectly straight FRONT head, looking directly at camera, head absolutely upright, both eyes on exactly the same horizontal baseline, nose and mouth centered on a vertical axis, matching ears at same height. No cocked head, no leaning, no yaw or 3/4 face. Tousled asymmetric hair is fine but face is square to camera.
MIDDLE CELL: true orthographic LEFT SIDE PROFILE, nose pointing directly left, only ONE eye visible, no far eye and no far cheek, ear directly behind jaw. Head vertical without tilt.
RIGHT CELL: straight BACK of same head, no face or eyes.
All three have identical hair identity, proportions, warm skin and soft painted shading. Draw head, hair, ears and a SHORT BARE SKIN NECK only. The bottom edge ends on SKIN. Absolutely NO fabric, NO white collar, NO shirt neckline, NO shoulder, NO jewelry. Neck must be plain skin with rounded bottom for overlapping the torso. Entire heads uncropped, no text, no grid, no background or shadows. Original premium hand-painted MMORPG sprite art.

name: heads-level-correction
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Fix the LEFTMOST FRONT-FACING head in this three-head transparent sprite atlas. Its facial features are still TILTED: the eye on the viewer's LEFT is lower than the eye on the viewer's RIGHT. This is unacceptable for the game. Redraw its face so BOTH PUPIL CENTERS ARE EXACTLY ON THE SAME HORIZONTAL LINE, same eye size, both ears on the same horizontal line, mouth corners on a horizontal line, chin directly below the nose and nose exactly midway between eyes. A completely bilateral-symmetric FACE seen dead straight on, symmetrical cheek widths. No cute head cocking, no tilt, no raised eyebrow. Hair may retain asymmetric locks. The front neck must be vertical with level bottom. Keep same identity, brown hair, amber eyes, painterly style. Keep the middle strict left profile and back view unchanged. Keep three equally spaced cells and transparent background, no clothes or collar on any head.

name: arms-front
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent sprite COMPONENT ATLAS for the same young-adult chibi fantasy adventurer as reference, matching painted ivory linen, warm tan skin, green bronze-embroidered Leafweave Coat. No complete body.
Square or 4:3 image, EXACT FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, twelve separated illustrations with generous margins, one component per cell. FRONT view. Every arm component hangs vertically with shoulder/elbow/wrist at TOP, fingers at BOTTOM. Painted softly rounded CLOSED ends overlap joints, no holes, no cutaway cavities, no blood.
ROW1 left to right:
1 RIGHT UPPER ARM ONLY (screen-left), cream linen short sleeve at top and a little bare upper arm below, from shoulder to elbow, NO forearm or hand.
2 LEFT UPPER ARM ONLY matching.
3 RIGHT BARE FOREARM ONLY, warm skin elbow to wrist, rounded fully painted ends, NO hand or sleeve.
4 LEFT BARE FOREARM ONLY matching.
ROW2:
1 RIGHT CLOSED GRIPPING HAND ONLY, small wrist stump at top, fingers curled at bottom holding invisible handle, no arm.
2 LEFT CLOSED GRIPPING HAND ONLY matching.
3 RIGHT GREEN COAT UPPER SLEEVE ONLY shoulder to elbow, green cloth with brass piping and leaf embroidery, broad rounded shoulder.
4 LEFT GREEN COAT UPPER SLEEVE ONLY matching.
ROW3:
1 RIGHT GREEN COAT ELBOW CUFF ONLY, short lower sleeve covering elbow and upper quarter of forearm, embroidered bronze hem, no skin.
2 LEFT GREEN COAT ELBOW CUFF ONLY matching.
3 RIGHT OPEN SPELLCASTING HAND ONLY, wrist at top, relaxed spread fingers pointing DOWN, open palm toward viewer, 5 fingers, no magical effects.
4 LEFT OPEN SPELLCASTING HAND ONLY matching.
These are 12 individual disjoint rig parts, not whole arms, not pairs in a single cell. No text, grid, cast shadows or backdrop. High quality warm hand-painted MMORPG illustration.

All hang vertically in resting pose: joint at TOP, fingertips at BOTTOM. 5 fingers per open hand. Rounded fully opaque joint overlap ends, no blood or hollow cutaways, no whole arms or full human. No text, no shadows, no background. Preserve recognizable outfit design.

name: bow-and-arrow
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / game asset. From the reference fantasy equipment atlas extract and redraw ONLY its Surveyor Bow as an isolated large sprite. Landscape transparent PNG 2:1 with TWO equal cells.
LEFT CELL: entire upright reddish-brown briar wood bow, bronze bindings and central brown leather grip, curved wooden limb on LEFT, tips on RIGHT. IMPORTANT REMOVE THE BOWSTRING ENTIRELY. No straight string between tips, no string at all; the game draws an animated bowstring. Preserve premium hand-painted illustrated style, no glow, no shadow. Bow silhouette tall and narrow with both tips reaching the same vertical axis to the right of the central grip.
RIGHT CELL: one matching arrow pointing exactly LEFT horizontally, sharp silver leaf-shaped tip on LEFT, thin wooden shaft and ivory feather fletching on RIGHT, no hand or bow. Isolated. No text or grid or extra items.
